note: Pinned ffmpeg for the Host's media tools (MP4 conversion, last-frame pictures, clip joins, MP3 samples). LGPL shared build: no GPL-only parts, no libx264. H.264 is encoded with the Windows Media Foundation encoder (h264_mf) that the OS provides. Source code of this exact build: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n8.1.3 (build recipe: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds, tag autobuild-2026-11-27-12-42). Release assets of old autobuild tags are removed upstream after a while: keep a copy of the pinned zip with the release artifacts.
